WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_media_type_averages,
  AVG(track_count) AS average_of_media_type_track_counts
FROM per_media_type;

assumptions.assumption: Uses SQLite-style REAL division to avoid integer division; NULLIF treats a zero duration as undefined, so AVG ignores that ratio, as it does missing values. Tracks with missing Bytes are excluded by the strict size filter.
